# The standard library must be imported. Built-ins are the one exception: they
# are dot-imported into every file implicitly, which is the only such magic.
! sngl check nostd.sngl
stderr 'undefined: text'

sngl check withstd.sngl
stdout 'withstd.sngl: ok'

# Built-ins need no import — types, their methods, and literals all resolve.
sngl check builtins.sngl
stdout 'builtins.sngl: ok'

# And cannot be imported: naming an ambient package would imply it were
# optional.
! sngl check importbuiltin.sngl
stderr 'always in scope'

# The alias form binds the same package under a name of the caller's choosing.
sngl check aliased.sngl
stdout 'aliased.sngl: ok'

-- nostd.sngl --
component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- withstd.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- builtins.sngl --
component main {
    var n int = int.max(1, 2)
    var f float = float.sqrt(2.0)
    var s string = string.upper("hi")
    var c color = color.rgb(1, 2, 3)
    var d date = "2026-08-21"
}
-- importbuiltin.sngl --
import . "sngl://builtin"

component main {
    var n int = 1
}
-- aliased.sngl --
import ui "sngl://std"

component main {
    ui.text(value="x")
}
